# @workspacekit/markdown

> A Markdown renderer for the file workspace: an editable rendered view with a source mode, built on Lexical.

- API reference: https://adityazero4.github.io/workspacekit/api/markdown
- Install: `npm install @workspacekit/markdown @workspacekit/code @workspacekit/react react react-dom`

## README sections

- Install
- Entry: `markdownRenderer()` returns a renderer.
- Standalone use: `MarkdownEditor` shows one file without a tree or a provider.
- CSS: Import `@workspacekit/react/styles.css` and `@workspacekit/markdown/styles.css` once each.
- Options: `source`: the renderer that draws source mode.
- Vite: No configuration is needed in a build or in the dev server.

## Entry points

- `@workspacekit/markdown`
- `@workspacekit/markdown/styles.css` (stylesheet)

## Exports of `@workspacekit/markdown`

- `MARKDOWN_MAX_BYTES`: The largest Markdown file the renderer reads: 10 MiB.
- `MARKDOWN_PARTS`: Every element this package renders carries `data-fs-part="<part>"`; these are its part names, all with the `md-` prefix.
- `MarkdownClassNames`: Extra class names per part of this package, merged after the part's own class.
- `MarkdownEditor`: A Markdown editor without a `FileSystemProvider`: the same WYSIWYG view as the registry entry (Lexical, loaded on first render), labelled "Contents of <fileName>" (or "File contents"), with the slash menu, the format toolbar (Alt+F10) and the Cmd/Ctrl+K link editor.
- `MarkdownEditorProps`: Props of `MarkdownEditor`: a controlled `value`, with every standalone viewer prop except `src`.
- `MarkdownMode`: The view modes of the Markdown renderer: the WYSIWYG `rendered` view (the default) and `source`.
- `MarkdownPart`: A part name of this package.
- `MarkdownRendererOptions`: Options of `markdownRenderer`.
- `SourceEditorProps`: Props of the editor `MarkdownEditor` uses for source mode.
- `markdownRenderer`: Creates the registry entry for Markdown files (`.md`, `.markdown`, `.mkd`, `.mdown`): an editable WYSIWYG view (Lexical, loaded when first shown) with a `source` mode.
